Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1419
Claimant:
William Johnson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2023-02-14
Claim opened after the claimant reported a low-speed collision in a parking lot while backing out of a space. The
claimant is unrepresented and has provided a contact number for follow-up.
2023-02-24
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the impact and describes the
collision as reported. Confirmed that the driver is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of
loss.
2023-04-19
Spoke with the claimant, who described the same sequence of events as in the initial call. The account of how the
vehicle moved and where the impact occurred has not changed.
2023-05-08
Obtained statements from two witnesses who saw the vehicles make contact in the lot. Both confirmed the accident
happened as the claimant described it.
2023-05-24
Received photographs from the scene and from the body shop. The daamge to the rear bumper and tailgate lines up
with the impact described and with the other driver's account.
2023-06-18
Contacted the other driver, who confirmed the collision occurred as reported and did not dispute the sequence of
events.
2023-06-30
Checked the vehicle history and prior repair records. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing
suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
2023-07-07
Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness following the collision and was seen at urgent care the same day. The kind
and force of the impact fit the reported symptoms well.
2023-07-13
Medical records show the claimant was treated for neck complaints within the past two years. That earlier condition is
adding to the current symptoms, so the prior history has been noted for the evaluation.
2023-07-14
Treatment followed a usual course of care, including physical therapy and medication. Recent notes show steady
improvement, and the frequency of visits has tapered as expected.
2023-08-14
Reviewed the current treatment plan with the claimant, who confirmed the same account of the accident and her
symptoms in each contact so far. No inconsistencies have been found in the file.
2023-09-15
Based on the records, witness statements, photos and vehicle damage, the claim is progressing normally. Remaining
items are the final treatment summary and the bills for review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
